name: The School of Future History
description: A Hexhaven school of divination and prophecy located at the base of the tower.

relations.note: Denzilore founded the school and is its dean.
relations.quote: Denzilore Fatehold founded this school to improve the outlook for the denizens of Echoverse Arcavios.
